domain: Travel optimization mobile app (React Native Expo)
design_philosophy: Fintech-meets-travel. Treat travel optimization like a financial portfolio. Total trip price is the hero metric. Avoid generic travel-app tropes (big landscape photos as primary content). Treat it as a data-driven decision engine.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/Art): Use Cabinet Grotesk for strong, architectural headings and tabular numbers. Use IBM Plex Sans for legible, dense body data.

layout_strategy.general: Mobile-first, dense and scannable. Utilize 'The Control Room' grid mentality.
layout_strategy.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl). Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), minimal shadow. No soft UI/Neumorphism.

search.layout: Simple, focused homepage. Large, thumb-friendly inputs (h-14). Use Bottom Sheets for date flexibility and 'Anywhere' selections. A prominent, high-contrast primary CTA.

loading.animation_concept: Engaging 'intelligent optimisation in progress'. Dark background with rapid data-scrubbing number animations, cycling text ('Optimising your trip...', 'Calculating flight volatility...', 'Scoring hotel value...', 'Building trip portfolio...'). Creates perceived intelligence.

results.layout: Vertical scroll list of 3 ranked Trip Cards (Cheapest, Best Value, Lowest Risk).

trip_card_blueprint.header: Row: Ranking Label (e.g. 'Cheapest') on left, small square destination thumbnail (e.g. 48x48) on right.
trip_card_blueprint.hero: Massive total combined price (e.g. '£349') taking up 30-40% of vertical space, using tabular numbers.
trip_card_blueprint.details: Two distinct rows or bento-style sections for Flight (airline, times, tiny icon) and Hotel (name, stars, distance).
trip_card_blueprint.action_row: Book now vs Wait badge taking precedence. Includes confidence score (e.g., 'Book Now - 92% Confidence').

components.price_prediction: Simple line chart visual (using a charting library) showing historical/predicted price trend to justify the 'Wait/Buy' recommendation.
components.itinerary: Timeline-style breakdown of flight legs and hotel stay.
components.ctas: Sticky bottom bar with affiliate 'Book Flight' and 'Book Hotel' split buttons.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these images STRICTLY for small destination thumbnails (e.g. 48x48 or 64x64) in the results and detail screens. Do NOT use them as full-bleed hero backgrounds.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='trip-card-price', data-testid='book-now-button', data-testid='budget-input').
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Use react-native-reanimated for smooth transitions but respect prefers-reduced-motion where applicable.
